name: Mire-rot Hilda
languages: Common and any three languages, Sylvan

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: Hilda makes three Arcane Burst attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Mire Sickness or (B) Spellcasting to cast *Ray of Sickness*.

Actions.name: Arcane Burst
Actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. 16 (3d8 + 3) Force damage.

Actions.name: Spellcasting
Actions.text:
Hilda casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** *Detect Magic*, *Light*, *Mage Armor*, *Mage Hand*, *Prestidigitation*
- **2/Day Each:** *Fireball*, *Invisibility*
- **1/Day Each:** *Cone of Cold*, *Fly*

Actions.name: Mire Sickness
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 14, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.expressedQuote: The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

Reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
Reactions.text: Hilda casts *Counterspell* or *Shield* in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Bonus Actions.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: Hilda casts *Misty Step*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

lore: Once a hedge-witch who hid in the fens from the village that would have burned her, she melted into the swamp and made a bargain with the rot, and now she takes the strength of anyone who strays into her water.

generation.userConcept: a marsh witch who curses trespassers, cr 7
generation.cite: composition after Spirit Naga (CR 8) — the or-form bite-and-ray with the debuff single
